definitionsAndScopeReview.diffraction: Acceptable wave spreading beyond the ray path; not frequency change.
definitionsAndScopeReview.coherence: Same frequency plus stable phase difference, explicitly limited to stable observable fringes; incoherent waves are not denied superposition.
definitionsAndScopeReview.phase: Stage within a cycle, followed by relative-phase reinforcement/cancellation.
definitionsAndScopeReview.frequencyAndWavelength: Time and space distinguished, inverse trend conditioned on equal wave speed.
definitionsAndScopeReview.amplitude: Greatest departure from equilibrium; arriving phases considered instead of simply adding positive sizes.
definitionsAndScopeReview.wavefront: Teaching bridge missing in both locales, d920-F02; not a claim that the existing wavefront label is scientifically false.
definitionsAndScopeReview.sphericalPatch: Small portion of the wavefront, not an opaque object or exclusive physical source; effective approximation retained.
definitionsAndScopeReview.microscopeResolution: Resolution versus magnification and ordinary-imaging scope acceptable; collection qualifier requires localized English correction, d920-F01.
definitionsAndScopeReview.telescopeResolution: Angular rather than spatial separation, finite opening, wavelength/diameter trend and common-condition qualifier acceptable.
definitionsAndScopeReview.geometricalOptics: Approximate ray model on relevant observation scale, not exact propagation at every scale.
definitionsAndScopeReview.transverse: Oscillation perpendicular to propagation, distinguished from diffraction spreading; curved fronts alone do not prove oscillation direction.
